- Uses minimal computational overhead (just confidence scoring + rule-based triggers).

*Example*:  
> *User*: "Explain quantum computing to a 10-year-old."  
> *AI*: "Confidence: 45% → **Try this**: Break it down into 3 simple parts (e.g., 'Imagine a magic box that…') and avoid jargon. I’ll help draft it!"
